Sent: 2/27/2024 3:26 PM
Subject: Summit Ridge Holdings

Vista Equity Group has gotten back to me and is vacillating on what they want to do with the Summit Ridge Holdings trades.  In particular, they haven't thought through what they want to do with the online trades, don't like on online documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the trades once they decide how to resolve this.  So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Apex Capital financial trades and master sit.
